commands.command:
"<USER>\\.cache\\codex-runtimes\\codex-primary-runtime\\dependencies\\native\\powershell\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path skills -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath mirror/current-export -Destination skills/current-export -Recurse
$sourcePath = (Resolve-Path input.json).Path
$sourceBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($sourcePath)
$sourceData = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($sourceBytes) | ConvertFrom-Json
$totalValue = ($sourceData.values | Measure-Object -Sum).Sum
$hashProvider = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
$inputDigest = [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hashProvider.ComputeHash($sourceBytes)).Replace('"'-', '').ToLowerInvariant()
"'$hashProvider.Dispose()
$resultData = [ordered]@{generation=$sourceData.generation;total=$totalValue;input_sha256=$inputDigest}
$outputPath = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path '"'output.json'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("'$outputPath, ($resultData | ConvertTo-Json) + [Environment]::NewLine, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))'
